script: Saturn has a giant hexagon-shaped storm at its north pole. Each side of the hexagon is wider than Earth. It was first spotted by the Voyager spacecraft in the 1980s. It has kept its six-sided shape for decades. Scientists think a jet stream of wind creates the strange pattern. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
